verdict.rationale: Segment documents a versioned Public API with an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, token auth, rate limits and pagination. It supports CRUD on workspace resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans, and the Profile API offers programmatic reads of the profiles shown in the UI's Profile explorer. However, nothing in the evidence claims full UI-API parity, and many UI features have no documented API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API management of Audiences, Functions, Reverse ETL, Privacy Portal/consent and Engage, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
